summary: Register CIAN as a classified property provider with fail-closed XML-feed generation and exact feed/import status reconciliation without inventing an API publication-write surface.

impacts.evidence: One tenant-bound connector Account resolves one immutable CIAN FeedURL; remote import evidence must match that URL exactly and caller requests cannot override account identity.

API keys remain callback-scoped. Generated XML can contain property address, phone and image data supplied by the host, so serving the feed remains subject to Task-060 privacy and host publication policy.
Task 039 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP/OpenAPI operation.
Task 039 consumes the existing classified publication-status SDK surface introduced by Task 038 and does not modify frozen Connector/Runtime roots or capability contracts.
No migration is added; feed URL and import identities remain host-owned connector configuration/mapping evidence.

Fixed public-api.cian.ru authority, Task-021 Bearer secret callback, exact FeedURL/order binding, HTTPS-only feed/photo policy, bounded response/XML size and fail-closed category validation constrain provider input and egress.
Runtime status is read-only. XML generation is not misdeclared as a provider API write; the host must run approval/compliance policy before serving or changing the registered CIAN feed.
The adapter returns bounded import observations and deterministic XML bytes only; host audit, mapping, approval and source lineage remain authoritative.
Status reconciliation binds both FeedURL and remote import/order ID and maps provider counters. There is no connector-side API write/retry ambiguity because CIAN publication remains pull-based XML.
Outbound API authority is fixed to public-api.cian.ru; feed/photo URLs are validated HTTPS inputs and webhook subscription is not admitted.
API errors and 429/service failures are normalized with bounded retry guidance; malformed or foreign import evidence degrades health instead of being accepted.
Suspend/disable the CIAN connector account and stop serving the configured feed URL to stop integration traffic; no schema rollback is required.
Deterministic tests cover exact feed/order binding, import-status mapping, sale/rent XML rules and invalid payloads; Task-064 provider candidate must pass all thirteen checks before completion.
